recorded.name: a training instance with GPU, process, uptime and a log; one without a public IP
calls: aws ec2 describe-instances --region us-east-1 --filters Name=instance-state-name,Values=running Name=instance-type,Values=g4dn.*,g5.*,p3.*,p4d.* --query Reservations[].Instances[].{Id:InstanceId,Type:InstanceType,IP:PublicIpAddress,Launch:LaunchTime} --output json
